# 包装&物流工具箱 — Packaging & Logistics Toolbox

> 免费在线的包装设计与物流测算工具集：纸盒刀模设计、集装箱装柜计算、条码标签设计、Markdown 编辑。四款工具全部在浏览器内运行，无需注册、无需上传任何数据。
>
> A free browser-based toolbox for packaging design and logistics planning: carton dieline (die-cut) design, container load planning, barcode label design, and Markdown editing. Every tool runs entirely in the browser — no sign-up, no data upload, no backend.

本站由独立开发者维护，面向包装设计、电商物流与外贸跟单场景。四款工具均为单页应用：源文件与生成结果全部留在本地浏览器，可离线使用，导出格式为行业通用标准（SVG / DXF / PDF / PNG / Excel）。

Maintained by an independent developer, aimed at packaging designers, e-commerce logistics teams and foreign-trade merchandisers. All four tools are single-page applications: source files and generated results stay in the local browser and work offline, exporting to industry-standard formats (SVG / DXF / PDF / PNG / Excel).

## 在线工具 / Online Tools

- [刀模设计 DieCut Designer](https://057300.xyz/diecut/): 参数化生成上千种标准纸盒刀模（carton dieline），实时预览，可导出 SVG / DXF / PDF，对接印刷打样。Parametric generation of 1200+ standard carton dielines with live preview and SVG/DXF/PDF export for print proofing.
- [装柜大师 Loader Master](https://057300.xyz/loader-master/): 集装箱 3D 装柜仿真与装箱计算，输出 3D 码放方案、装载率与总重统计。3D container load simulation and bin-packing, producing a 3D pallet layout with utilization and total-weight metrics.
- [标签编辑器 Label Editor](https://057300.xyz/label-editor/): 浏览器内的矢量条码标签设计工具，支持 Code 128 / QR 等条码二维码、多对象编排、模板复用、PDF / PNG 导出与 Excel 批量套打。A vector barcode and QR label designer in the browser: Code 128 / QR support, multi-object layout, template reuse, PDF/PNG export and Excel batch printing.
- [Markdown 编辑器 Lite MD Editor](https://057300.xyz/lite_MD_editor/): 类 Word 的本地 Markdown 可视化编辑器，完全离线运行，支持 PDF 导出。A local, offline Markdown editor with Word-like visual editing and PDF export.
